payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates through the non-decreasing array a. When a[i] != a[i-1], outputs a[i-1] to increase MEX; otherwise outputs the smallest non-negative integer not in the set of all a values, then increments it.
payload.rationale: The solution exploits the sorted order of a to decide when to insert the previous MEX. It greedily maintains a pointer to the next available number that won't prematurely affect the MEX. No optimization objective, just a valid construction.
